name: shop-quanar
description: The shop's quanar: one server process. It opens the apis, creates the tables, checks permissions and validations and carries events for the quans it loads.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/quan-host/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --outfile=dist/quan-host.cjs
